claims: WrestleMania 42 takes place on Saturday, April 18, and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place from Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
The main show of WrestleMania 42 starts at 6 p.m. ET both nights.
The main show of WrestleMania 42 starts at 3 p.m. PT both nights.
The main show start time of WrestleMania 42 is 5 p.m. CT.
The kickoff pre-show of WrestleMania 42 begins at 3 p.m. ET.
The kickoff pre-show of WrestleMania 42 begins at noon PT.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on ESPN+ in the U.S.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on Netflix internationally.
There is select coverage of WrestleMania 42 on ESPN2.
John Cena is the host of WrestleMania 42.
